purpose: Sha-pinned EXEMPTION ledger for commits whose provenance is PRESENT and human-readable but does not satisfy `arifi_sync provenance --strict`, and whose only repair would be amending published, tagged, series-pinned history. A row here does NOT make its commit compliant and is not a repair: it records, per sha, exactly what is wrong and why it was not fixed. The audit reports these separately from clean commits and never folds them into a bare PASS.
law: This ledger is DISTINCT from native-grandfather.json, which is CLOSED and covers commits predating the 2026-08-20 native-Origin convention - nothing is ever added there. It is also distinct from pending-trailers.json, which records trailer text OWED by commits on UNMERGED branches, to be pasted when that work reaches arifi/main; the commits below are already on arifi/main. New commits must carry correct trailers and must never be added here: the commit-msg hook rejects the defect at write time.
